description: Recurring topic-brief team: research a topic, stress-test the findings, write the brief.

members.context: Topic-brief assignment background plus source-access notes: use web sources first, fall back to workspace files under the provided directory, and record every source URL or file path alongside the claim it supports.
members.goal: Gather cited facts on the assigned topic and produce a source-backed findings bundle; succeed when every key claim carries at least one verifiable source.

members.context: Topic-brief quality bar: the brief must be accurate, scoped to the assignment, and free of unsupported claims; attack the researcher findings bundle against that bar and cite the weak points by claim.
members.goal: Stress-test the researcher findings bundle and return a verdict with supporting objections; succeed when every material weakness is named with its evidence.

members.context: Topic-brief deliverable: a Markdown brief for the requester built from the vetted researcher findings and the critic verdict; keep it scoped to the assignment and note any dissent the critic raised.
members.goal: Write the final topic brief from the vetted findings; succeed when the brief covers every vetted finding in clean Markdown with sources attached.

name: research-trio
